audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] all read 'Morgana' — the two layers disagree on who wins every stage, and the packet's own levelChart (all Morgana) plus the 52.13% Maokai overall winrate defect note confirms lane-phase favor sits with Morgana even though Maokai's kit (engage/peel) wins the game overall.
audit.why: Dark Binding (10s CD, 1250 range) out-ranges Maokai's entire kit including W Twisted Advance (525 range dash), and Black Shield negates the W root/knockup and R root outright, so Morgana wins the lane exchanges stage by stage even though Maokai's late engage value pulls the overall matchup winrate to 52%.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..6].side to Morgana to match win[0..6], and rewrite each .why to state the actual mechanical reason (Dark Binding range/CD, Black Shield negating engage, Soul Shackles) instead of the templated tree-favor language.

audit.why: phases[4].label 'Level 6' and phases[5]/[6] correctly track R Nature's Grasp coming online and first/second item CDR reducing Dark Binding and Black Shield uptime.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contains no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) despite Morgana's Q being a flat 10s cooldown and Maokai's Q scaling 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s and R 130/110/90s — real numbers that make the timing advice actionable are missing.
audit.why: Riot kit data gives Dark Binding a flat 10s cooldown and Bramble Smash 7s at rank 1; stating these lets a reader actually count down the window instead of reading vague prose.
audit.corrected: Rewrite breakdown.cooldowns with the real cooldown numbers.
